verdict.rationale: Box's developer guides document creating shared links on files, folders and web links through the API, including an open shared link on a file. They also describe configurable access levels, which covers creation and visibility. The pack never mentions password protection, expiry dates, or removing or revoking a shared link through the API, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: password setting, expiry setting, API revocation of shared links, independent/hands-on corroboration.
